author: Niels Bosma
subject: Add IvyML Studio, XamlBuilder sugar, and CodeInput Ghost variant
body:
- XamlBuilder: support dotted slot sugar (<Card.Header> == <Slot Name="Header">)
  and inner-text shorthand for string Content props, with tests.
- Inputs: add non-generic default records (NumberInput, SelectInput, DateTimeInput,
  etc.) so IvyML can reference widgets without type arguments.
- CodeInput: add Ghost variant and XML language support; ToCodeInput now applies
  the language argument.
- IvyML: new `parse` command for validating markup without rendering; screenshot
  service waits for the widget tree to render (configurable --timeout) instead of
  capturing a blank page.
- New Ivy.IvyML.Studio app for authoring IvyML with chat, code, and preview views.
